positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Amazon Interactive Video Service (2019 - 2021)
• Video Ingest (2018 - 2021)
• Clips (2016 - 2018)

• Built from scratch and scaled an HLS Master Playlist server in Go on AWS ECS Fargate to hundreds of thousands RPS across 4 worldwide regions using cell-based architecture while serving legacy TV, mobile, and web clients.

• Took ownership of the real-time video data pipeline service that collected stream metadata from hundreds of thousands of streams every 3 seconds under 5-second read processing time using Amazon Kinesis and S3.

• Implemented centralized structured logging for hundreds of thousands of bare metal hosts, reducing log volume by 20x and significantly reducing time to diagnosis by 300%.

• Designed DRM and Geoblocking features for the inaugural NFL Thursday Night football broadcast, working with various cross-functional teams to meet the strict NFL requirements.

• Served on-call duty for AWS IVS and Twitch Video Core, ensuring service availability to millions of users and handling various Sev-2 incidents.

• Proposed and designed a continuous test module for transcode system with Cloudwatch Alarm and PagerDuty. Achieving 99.99% uptime.

• Led a cross-team project to increase the total video broadcast capacity by 25% by bringing up a new suite of bare metal servers and peripheral AWS services for a new video processing origin.

• Contributed to the launch of Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS) by repurposing various parts of existing Twitch video systems such as playback authentication, video metadata database, and analytics reporting.

• Developed the Clips Manager feature, which allows search and deletion of clips, and optimized PostgresSQL indexes to allow searching and filtering.

• Implemented the frontend for Twitch Clips page using React, Typescript, and GraphQL, including autoplay suggestion, video player, tracking, and chat modules.

projects.title: The Surge Club
projects.description:
A web app that helps Uber and Lyft drivers predict surge areas before the surge happen so they can be in the right place to make money
- Won 1st place prize from Google, 2nd place prize from Uber, and 3rd place prize from Lyft
- Integrated external APIs into Uber Surge spots prediction engine 
Tech Stack: Python, React, Redux, Node.js and Firebase
